ShortDescription.Value: Cities: Skylines 2 Multiplayer mod, build your city with your friendc

Publish.LongDescription:
Build one city together.
CS2 Multiplayer Mod is a cooperative multiplayer mod for Cities: Skylines II. One player hosts the city, everyone else joins and downloads it, and from that moment roads, zoning, services, finances, progression, time and weather stay in sync while you build together. The goal of the project is a shared city that feels like normal Cities: Skylines II - the same tools, the same city, just with your friends in it.
## Included features
- Cooperative sessions in one shared city, started from a brand new world or from a city you already built. - Steam Relay hosting: the host shares a join code, no router setup, no address to type. Works for everyone who owns the game on Steam. - Direct connection hosting: automatic port opening through UPnP, a LAN Only mode for local play, and support for every copy of the game, including Xbox App, Microsoft Store and Game Pass. - Host controls: password, max players, player approval with optional auto-approval for Steam friends, kick and ban, and a client resync policy (Allow, Ask Host, Host Only). - Synchronized building: roads, rails and other networks, upgrades, replacements and elevation, zoning, buildings, services, terrain, trees and props, transport lines and routes, city and street names. - Synchronized city state: money and loans, milestones and unlocks, time of day, game speed and pause, and weather. - Optional detailed simulation sync: growable buildings, household occupancy, company tenancy and production, rent and zone demand - with a host switch to turn it off in very large cities where the extra work costs frames. - Partner markers: every player gets a colour, and you see where they are, what they hover and what they are about to place. - In-game multiplayer panel and chat, with /sync for a one-click world sync whenever two screens disagree. - Save Copy: keep the shared city on your own PC and continue it later in single-player. - Compatibility checks before anyone connects: mod version, game version, DLC and active mods, each with a plain error message and a help link. - Nine languages, following your game language: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Russian, Japanese and Simplified Chinese.
## Usage
Hosting:
1. Open Options, CS2 Multiplayer Mod, and set your player name. Port, password, max players and LAN Only live there too. 2. On the main menu click Multiplayer, then Host Game. 3. Pick a connection. Steam Relay needs no setup. Direct connection is faster but the host's port has to be reachable, and it is the only option on Xbox App, Microsoft Store and Game Pass copies. 4. Share the join code (Steam Relay), or your address and port (direct connection). 5. Choose Load World for an existing city or Create World for a new one. 6. The session starts on its own once the city has finished loading. You can also start hosting from the in-game multiplayer panel while a city is already open.
Joining:
1. Click Multiplayer, then Join Game. 2. Enter the join code, or the host address and port, plus your player name and the password. 3. Click Join Session and wait while the host's city is transferred. Large cities take longer, and the dialog closes itself once you are in.
Full guides, including port forwarding and every error message: https://cs2multiplayer.rollocraft.me/
## Known issues and limitations (in the current version)
- Citizens, vehicles, tourists and pets are not replicated one by one. Each PC runs its own agents, so traffic and crowds can look different on each screen while the city, its buildings and its finances stay in sync. - The host owns the session save. A joining player plays in a temporary downloaded copy of the city, and changes made after the connection ends cannot be sent back. Use Save Copy to keep it. - Every player needs the same mod version, the same game version and the same gameplay DLC. Radio station DLC does not matter, and CS1 Treasure Hunt is ignored because it cannot be disabled. - Steam Relay hosting needs the Steam copy of the game, launched through Steam and online. Microsoft Store, Game Pass and Xbox App copies host over a direct connection instead. - Joining a very large city takes a while, because the whole world is transferred first. - The session can still decide to resync a player: the world reloads from the host and play continues. Reducing the remaining causes is ongoing work.
## Compatibility with other modifications
- Hosting and joining are blocked while any unsupported mod is active in your playset, including asset-only mods such as maps, prop packs and prefab packs. Nothing in the sync layer accounts for an unverified mod changing prefabs, tools or the simulation, so one unsupported mod on one PC is enough to desync or crash the session. - Officially supported, tested and maintained: Traffic, Road Speed Adjuster, Anarchy, Find It and Asset Icon Library. These never block a session. - Durable state belonging to compatible mods, such as Traffic's custom lane connections, is synchronized between players. - Options, CS2 Multiplayer Mod, General, Ignore Mod Compatibility Checks (Own Risk) lifts the local block for advanced users. It does not bypass the network protocol, game version or DLC checks, and it does not make another mod multiplayer-aware. - Every player needs the same mod list. The safest playset is this mod plus the supported ones above.
## Saving
The host saves the city exactly as in single-player, and that save is the session. A city built in multiplayer stays an ordinary Cities: Skylines II save and keeps working without the mod.
A joining player's copy is temporary and is closed when the session ends. Save Copy in the multiplayer panel writes the current shared city to your own PC so you can continue it alone.
## Plans
Wider tested-mod compatibility, fewer resyncs, better performance in very large cities, and keeping pace with every Cities: Skylines II patch. Playtests and the bug reports that come out of them drive what gets fixed first, so joining one is the fastest way to shape the next version.
## Feedback, feature ideas, support
The Discord server is the preferred place for support, bug reports and playtests: https://discord.gg/KFZTW2YSJt
Larger feature requests and anything that needs a longer discussion are easier to track as GitHub Issues: https://github.com/Rollocraft/CS2MultiplayerMod

Publish.ChangeLog: Version 1.7.1 Added the full server options to the normal Host Game flow, including player approval, simulation sync, Steam-friend auto-approval, and client resync policy controls. Added host approval prompts for client resync requests. Added batched synchronization for dense tree and prop brush placement and deletion. Added synchronization support for durable state used by compatible third-party mods and improved residential household income correction. Improved Steam Relay transfer-rate recovery under stale congestion reports. Milestone popups now close automatically after 10 seconds in multiplayer so an AFK player cannot hold the session paused. Clients now receive the native popup for newly reached host milestones, including milestone 1, without replaying earlier milestones or duplicating development points. Fixed release packages that could omit the multiplayer UI bundle, causing the main-menu button, in-game button, and milestone countdown to be missing. The Options page now shows the mod version on its General tab, and the read-only status rows there were removed.
